description:
Brand Introduction:
Innovacore is a trusted brand known for designing high-quality, innovative ear care products. Our mission is to offer safe, effective, and comfortable solutions for ear health, tailored to both kids and adults. We pride ourselves on creating products that make ear care easier, safer, and more effective than ever before. With an emphasis on thoughtful design and superior functionality, Innovacore delivers products that help maintain the health and hygiene of your ears.

Product Description:
Innovacore Ear Wax Removers are precision-engineered tools designed for gentle, effective ear cleaning. We offer a range of custom-designed ear wax removal tools, including wands specifically tailored for both children and adults. Each product is made from high-quality, medical-grade materials to ensure safety and durability. The easy-to-use design ensures a comfortable experience while providing a deeper, safer cleaning compared to traditional cotton swabs. Innovacore’s ear care products promote hygiene while preventing damage to the delicate ear canal. 

- For Kids: Soft, ergonomic, and designed with safety in mind, the Innovacore Kids Ear Wax Remover features rounded tips and is made from gentle, non-toxic materials.
- For Adults: A sleek, efficient ear wax remover with an ergonomic handle for comfort and precision, designed for thorough, safe ear cleaning.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
- Safe & Gentle: Designed to minimize risk of ear injury, especially for kids, while being more effective than cotton swabs.
- **Custom Designed for All Ages:** Special versions available for both children and adults.
- High-Quality Materials: Made with premium, non-toxic, and hypoallergenic materials to ensure safety and comfort.
- Eco-Friendly: Reusable, reducing the need for disposable products like cotton swabs.
- Easy to Use: Ergonomic and user-friendly design for an effortless cleaning experience.
  
Innovacore stands out by combining safety, comfort, and efficiency, providing customers with a superior ear care experience for the whole family.

Payment Terms:
- Commission Rate: Affiliates will earn a commission of 20% per sale made through their unique referral link.
- Payment Frequency: Payments will be made on a [monthly/bi-weekly] basis via [PayPal/Bank Transfer].
- Cookie Duration: Affiliates will receive credit for sales made within [30-60 days] of the customer clicking their referral link.
- Referral Tracking: Affiliates can track their performance and commissions through a user-friendly affiliate portal.

Other Information:
- Marketing Assets: Affiliates will receive access to a variety of marketing materials such as banners, product images, and pre-written copy to help promote Innovacore products effectively.
- Affiliate Support: We offer a dedicated support team to assist affiliates with any questions or challenges they may face.
- Promotional Restrictions: Affiliates must adhere to ethical marketing practices and refrain from engaging in spammy or misleading promotions.
- Exclusive Promotions: Affiliates will have access to exclusive offers or discounts to further promote the product and incentivize their audience.

Additional Affiliate Program Features:
- Tiered Commission Structure: Reward top-performing affiliates with higher commission rates or bonuses to encourage growth.
- Affiliate Dashboard: An easy-to-use dashboard to track clicks, conversions, and commissions.
